svg.title: Authority · CyberAlchemy Lab concept map
svg.desc: Definitions specify meaning, Artifact Types specify record formats, Relation Kinds specify permitted connections, and policies limit actions and effects. Select a node for its role, example and connections. Arrows are explanatory role connections.

g.title: The applicable accepted definitions determine what the terms mean for this purpose.
The selected Artifact Type sets the required record format.
Connection rules state meaning, direction, allowed record kinds and required additional details.
Policies, constitutions and permissions limit actions and their effects.
The thing examined refers to the selected definition for its meaning.
The record-format requirements specify fields and constraints for the thing being examined.
The rule states which kinds of records may connect, in which direction, and with which details.
Applicable rules and authority limits constrain the changes the transaction may apply.
